children: ), a technology platform that brings performance marketing to Connected TV, today announced it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 after the close of the U.S. markets on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. MNTN management will host a live webcast to discuss the results and provide a business update on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time.

The live webcast, pre-registration for the event, and any related materials can be accessed from both the Quarterly Results and the Events & Presentations pages of the MNTN investor relations website.
A replay of the webcast will also be accessible through the MNTN investor relations website shortly following the call and will be available for at least seven days.
